claim_statement: MMP11 shows higher expression in LUAD tumour than normal tissue in the project TCGA-LUAD analysis.
supported_interpretation: The frozen S0 contrast reports logFC +5.18003235678542 and BH FDR 1.79025769607393e-37.
not_supported: Expression association does not establish disease causality or therapeutic actionability.
required_qualifier: State the Tumor-minus-Normal contrast and project-dataset boundary.
major_remaining_uncertainty: Cell-type attribution and causal relevance remain unresolved.

claim_statement: The direction of the project-derived MMP11 tumour-normal association is concordant across all six prespecified sensitivity models.
supported_interpretation: S1-S6 retain TUMOR_HIGHER direction and BH FDR below 0.05.
not_supported: Sensitivity models are not independent biological replications.
required_qualifier: State that all models use the same TCGA-LUAD biological dataset.
major_remaining_uncertainty: Robust model direction cannot resolve dataset-specific bias or causality.

claim_statement: MMP11 tumour-associated expression observations exist in additional external transcriptomic datasets and analyses.
supported_interpretation: Eligible external transcriptomic observations include TCGA, GEO, array, and single-cell contexts.
not_supported: External TCGA reanalysis is not independent of the project dataset; histology and accession specificity vary.
required_qualifier: Separate same-dataset TCGA corroboration from potentially distinct accession-resolved GEO observations.
major_remaining_uncertainty: Dataset reuse, mixed histology, and unresolved accessions limit replication claims.

claim_statement: MMP11 protein or tissue-associated observations have been reported in LUAD patient samples.
supported_interpretation: Eligible IHC, tissue-protein, serum, and stromal observations are retained by cohort.
not_supported: Protein or serum observation is not diagnostic validation or therapeutic causality.
required_qualifier: Identify cohort, assay, histology specificity, and tissue-versus-serum context.
major_remaining_uncertainty: Small cohorts, mixed histology, localization, and diagnostic specificity remain limitations.

claim_statement: Experimental perturbation involving MMP11 altered growth-related and/or migration-invasion phenotypes in reported lung cancer cell models.
supported_interpretation: Direct LUAD CRISPR/depletion/rescue observations and an insufficiently resolved lung-cancer axis study are represented separately.
not_supported: Cell-model perturbation does not establish patient efficacy or safety.
required_qualifier: Distinguish direct LUAD models from insufficiently histology-resolved rescue evidence.
major_remaining_uncertainty: Off-target effects, model specificity, and cross-publication replication remain unresolved.

claim_statement: Preclinical xenograft experiments reported reduced tumour growth after MMP11 depletion or anti-MMP11 intervention.
supported_interpretation: One genetic-depletion xenograft and one antibody xenograft observation are retained.
not_supported: Xenograft response is not clinical efficacy or human safety.
required_qualifier: State that the antibody xenograft is one record classified under intervention but also in vivo.
major_remaining_uncertainty: Both experiments arise from one publication and A549 xenograft context.

claim_statement: Clinical and prognostic associations involving MMP11 are context-dependent and include null findings.
supported_interpretation: All seven null records, contextual results, and insufficiently LUAD-specific clinical associations are preserved.
not_supported: These records cannot be collapsed into a binary favourable/unfavourable vote.
required_qualifier: Report null findings and histology/cohort limitations alongside associations.
major_remaining_uncertainty: Retrospective cohorts, computational predictions, mixed histology, and endpoint heterogeneity remain.

claim_statement: No relevant registered MMP11 clinical-development study was identified within the bounded frozen Task #039B ClinicalTrials.gov check.
supported_interpretation: Five lexical hits were screened and excluded as unrelated.
not_supported: Bounded search absence is not proof that no study exists globally.
required_qualifier: State the frozen query scope and lexical false-positive exclusions.
major_remaining_uncertainty: Registry indexing, terminology, and future record changes limit the search conclusion.

claim_statement: Mechanistic and pathway observations involving MMP11 exist, but they remain model- and context-dependent.
supported_interpretation: Regulatory, stromal, immune, signalling, and computational-network observations are represented.
not_supported: Association, downstream readout, or inferred network position is not a complete causal mechanism.
required_qualifier: Name the exact model, perturbation, and whether MMP11 itself was directly changed.
major_remaining_uncertainty: Many records use downstream readouts, mixed NSCLC models, or unresolved dataset lineage.

claim_statement: Anti-MMP11 antibody experiments reported effects in bounded in-vitro and xenograft models.
supported_interpretation: Three antibody evidence units cover growth, migration, and xenograft readouts.
not_supported: Preclinical antibody effects do not establish clinical efficacy, safety, specificity, or validated intervention status.
required_qualifier: Retain shared publication, reagent, and model dependencies.
major_remaining_uncertainty: Independent reagent validation, exposure, safety, and replication are unresolved.
